title: ‘They learn the job doing the job’: the project helping UK’s Neets into work
summary_full: Labour’s plan to get young unemployed people into work involves overhaul of welfare support, but for those with disabilities, specialist help is crucialWhen Rory Bowman finished school he joined the cohort of almost a million Neets – young people not in education, employment or training – around the country.The 21-year-old has autism and said he was exhausted after struggling for support in mainstream education for years. He didn’t think he could manage university, but couldn’t find a job or training that would accommodate his neurodivergence. Continue reading...
